The '''Andalia system''' was located in the [[Lorelli Reach]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was connected by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Lorell Route]] to the [[Lorell system/Legends|Lorell]] and [[Sennex system/Legends|Sennex systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Andalia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the origin point of the article of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] known as the [[Andalian cloak]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|353|Yeb, Solipo}}</ref> as well as the [[Andalian tapestry]].<ref name="Big Quince">{{JournalCite|2|Big Quince (short story)}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Andalian cloak]] and the [[Andalian tapestry]]|system=Andalia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Andalia system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
